question: How does local ISIS-II PL/M-80 V4.0 pass ADDRESS followed by BYTE?

toolchain.simulator: z80pack Intel Intellec MDS-800 Simulator Release 1.39
toolchain.toolchain_disk_recipe_note: The local isis-ii-43.dsk recipe labels PLM80 and OV0-OV4 V4.0 and OV5-OV6 V3.1. This run did not trace per-overlay opens; actual overlay provenance/use remains unresolved.

documented_expectation.source: Intel PL/M linkage convention description (see README.md and DISASSEMBLY.md)
documented_expectation.expected_for_this_signature: first ADDRESS X in BC, with B high and C low; second BYTE Y in E

observed_v4_machine_code: MVI E,2AH sets the second BYTE actual Y.
LXI B,36A4H directly loads the OBJ address into BC; B=36H is high and C=A4H is low.
Immediately before CALL 368DH, argument values are BC=36A4H and E=2AH. The caller does not establish D for argument passing; its value is not inferred.
At P entry, LXI H,36A7H; MOV M,E stores Y; DCX H; MOV M,B stores X's high address byte at 36A6H; DCX H; MOV M,C stores X's low byte at 36A5H; RET.
Listing gives MAIN relative code 0000H size 13, P relative code 000DH size 9, OBJ data offset 0, X offset 1 size 2, Y offset 3 size 1.
LOCATE places CODE 3680H-3695H, STACK 3696H-36A3H, and DATA 36A4H-36A7H.
LINK includes only ADBYTE.OBJ(MAIN); PLM80.LIB was not needed for this sample.
cross_fixture_pattern: Tested position 1: BYTE uses C in the one-BYTE and two-BYTE samples; ADDRESS uses BC in the one-ADDRESS and ADDRESS+BYTE samples.
Tested position 2: BYTE uses E in BYTE+BYTE and ADDRESS+BYTE; ADDRESS uses DE in BYTE+ADDRESS.
The observed results are consistent with Intel's documented convention for these tested cases; they do not establish a complete ABI/allocation algorithm.
unresolved_questions: Three or more parameters and any register-to-stack overflow behavior are untested.
WORD types, other parameter expressions, return values, external procedures, recursion, interrupts, and other compiler versions are not established.
The mixed-recipe disk's per-overlay provenance and whether OV5/OV6 were opened remain unverified.
